faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst podtrac.com) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; Texte aus dem Begleittext des Podcasters, kein Transkript - ohne Zeitachse sind Clips und Sprungmarken unmoeglich

einzeiler: Karoline Borega's story from Betrayal Season 4 adapts into a Hulu docu-series.
kurzfassung: Andrea Gunning revisits memorable moments from Betrayal Season 4 featuring Karoline Borega. The episode shares behind-the-scenes stories from the production process. It also provides a preview of the docu-series Betrayal: Dirty Secrets.
stichpunkte: Revisiting memorable moments from Betrayal Season 4
Karoline Borega's story adapted into a Hulu docu-series
Preview of the new show Betrayal: Dirty Secrets
beschreibung:
Karoline Borega's unforgettable story from Betrayal Season 4 is now a docu-series on Hulu, Betrayal: Dirty Secrets. In this special bonus episode, Andrea Gunning revisits some of the season's most memorable moments, shares behind-the-scenes stories, and offers a preview of what you’ll see in the new show.
You can now stream Karoline's story on Hulu and Disney+.
If you would like to share your story, you can reach out to the Betrayal team by emailing us at betrayalpod@gmail.com. You can also find us on Instagram at @betrayalpod and @glasspodcasts.
